authorization: User explicitly authorized the initial commit, private repository creation, remote setup and initial push.
status: Prepublication content review; remote publication is verified separately after push.

scanner.limitations: Heuristic detection is not proof that all possible credentials are absent. No scanner or live-input gate was weakened.

accepted_noncredential_findings.reason: Upstream help uses illustrative authentication-header syntax, not a credential. Exact placeholder content was checked in memory.
The detector matches its own regular-expression variable declaration; this is executable syntax, not credential data.
Assignment syntax in synthetic negative-test inputs; inspected matches contain only source punctuation or the known test canary.
Synthetic fake-glab trace intentionally contains a known canary to test sanitization; no service credential.
Synthetic sanitization and detector-rejection fixtures with known canaries and an invalid-domain example.

acceptance_scope: Only these exact blobs and match locations are accepted for this publication. Any changed hash or additional finding requires fresh review. The final index must be rescanned including this record.
lead_checks: Scanned all 162 staged blobs, not only working-tree files; all unlisted blobs passed the existing heuristic.
Compared flagged values with expected syntax or synthetic literals in memory without printing matched values.
Confirmed the working tree matches the index and no ignored files were staged.
Confirmed existing Git author and committer identity is the authorized account; no Git configuration changed.

independent_review.method: Read-only working-tree context and supplemental pattern review; no independent Git hash computation or test execution claimed.
independent_review.result: Conditional approval for exact-blob publication exceptions; lead reconciled the match count to seven and verified index identity.
independent_review.limits: Supplemental findings were synthetic tests, documentation metadata or upstream help examples. This remains a bounded review, not exhaustive secret-detection assurance.

raw_evidence.decision: Retain captured EOF blank lines and original hashes; the two whitespace warnings are accepted only for these raw evidence files.

historical_records: Earlier implementation records describing an uninitialized/unpublished workspace remain dated history. This separately authorized publication supersedes that state, without changing product-integration evidence.
ci: The initial push may trigger the existing dependency-installing validation workflow. It uses no paid models or Copilot credentials.
